question: Does current integer quantization materially change held-out-file development predictions from identical floating-point weights?
assignment: For each class, sort whole-file groups by SHA256(file UTF-8); assign index modulo 5. Never split a file.
training: Within each fold only: first 20 training rows per class seed an 8-step base; pooled train uses 120 steps, original class weighting, learning rate, regularizer and features.
comparison: Compare identical pooled float64 weights against original scale=1024 rounding/clipping; no hyperparameter search.
report: All folds, out-of-fold predictions, class confusion, per-file errors, feature collision labels and quantization disagreements.
restrictions: Only original train.json may be loaded as data. No calibration, evaluation or consumer data. No adoption, reward or independent efficacy claims. This is development data reused from historical training.
stop: Complete five fixed folds once, retain all outcomes, do not change model or quantization absent an independently validated case.
